name: BillOfMaterialsExplorer
tagline: Multi-level BOM with cost, quantity and lead-time roll-up, where-used and revision compare.
description: Explore a multi-level bill of materials in Canvas apps, Model-driven apps and Power Pages: indented tree with scrap-aware quantity and cost roll-up, critical lead time, consolidated parts list for a build quantity, where-used, effectivity and revision compare with cost delta, CSV export and a phone drill-down view.
features: Indented BOM tree with make/buy/phantom/reference badges
Quantity (with scrap), cost and lead-time roll-up
Unit and build cost KPIs, critical lead time, make/buy split
Consolidated, sortable parts list for any build quantity
Search with auto-expand and type filters
CSV export and 18 outputs plus a browser event
